verdict.rationale: Drive's own sharing docs say you can control whether people can edit, comment on, or only open a shared file, and the API defines writer/commenter roles. That implies multiple collaborators can edit files in place. A community comment confirms Docs, Sheets and Slides exist alongside Drive, but nothing in the pack documents simultaneous browser-based co-editing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of real-time multi-user co-editing, in-browser editing of docs/sheets/slides, presence/cursor or conflict handling, and independent hands-on corroboration.
